## Triage: first grade, `documentation` · `priority:p3` · `domain:devx` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue`. Accepted as the close-out of the "nothing writes `manager_id`" family

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T09:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** `content/docs/**`, so `domain:devx`.
- **Why p3:** a docs page says the product cannot do what Setup → Users → Set Manager does.
- **Close-out:** this is the third place this sentence was found false, after #17995 (`ApproverType.describe()`) and `automation/approvals.mdx` (PR #22625, #22584).
  - The PR greps every published text (`content/docs/**`, `packages/spec/src/**` describes, `skills/**`) for the claim that nothing sets `manager_id`, and fixes each hit. The grep goes in the PR body.
  - A hit in `skills/**` is Tier H. It is named in the PR and carried to the skills lane, not edited here.
- **Direction:** as filed. The callout names the Set Manager action and the admin endpoint; provisioning stays the bulk path; and the "request waits" clause, if kept, matches `onEmptyApprovers` on `main`.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01Q7Fy4uVkvBWgj9CLihdATJ`
Account: `marchtian` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-22662-capabilities-set-manager`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22662`
Domain: `domain:devx`
Seat: `domain:devx#1`
File surface: `content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx` (the warn callout, about `:15`–`:20` on `origin/main`), plus any other hand-written `content/docs/**` page that the family grep triage `6096320437` asks for finds stating that nothing in the product sets `manager_id`. Each such page is named in the PR body. A hit in `packages/spec/src/**` or `skills/**` is ⛔ not edited. It is named in the PR body and the report, because the first is the spec lane's contract text and the second is Tier H. ⛔ No `content/docs/references/**`, ⛔ no `content/docs/releases/**`, ⛔ no runtime change. (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `S`, judged as `M` (the replacement must match the product: the Set Manager action, the admin endpoint and `onEmptyApprovers` on `main`), `mode:subagent`, `model: opus — the default tier; dispatch-gates --tier: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card (a docs correction; no runtime change)`
Thread-read: 6096320437
Serial constraints cleared: `no open PR touches content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx (12 open PRs' file lists read). The family's other page, content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx, landed today in PR #22657 (ee3ae0360d) and is not in this surface.` — read at 2026-10-10T10:06Z

**Labels in this act:** `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`; assignee `marchtian`.

## ACCEPT — PR #22681 (head `992302698c`)

`domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023) · `marchtian` · `session_01Q7Fy4uVkvBWgj9CLihdATJ` · 2026-10-10T13:04Z. Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report.

- **Shape:** draft, base `main`, the first line `Fixes #22662`, then `Clause-②: no`. The full-body closing-keyword scan finds only `#22662`. Two files, +19/−12, no governed surface. `skip-changeset` and the PR assignee `marchtian` are set.
- **File surface:** `capabilities/approvals.mdx` is the claimed page. `automation/approvals.mdx` is a family-grep hit, and claim `6096404023` already admits "any other hand-written `content/docs/**` page the family grep … finds". This seat's re-read finds no other open PR touching either file (9 read). Recorded here as the claim's surface for this landing.
- **Each sentence checked against `origin/main`:**
  - "editing the user does not set it": the managed-update whitelist is `{name,image,locale}` (`auth-route-ledger.ts`, the `set-user-manager` row).
  - "A platform admin sets it … Set Manager, which calls `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager`": `auth-plugin.ts` mounts the route behind `gateAdmin(c)`, and `sys-user.object.ts` declares `set_user_manager` with that target.
  - The bulk import "reads a `manager_id` column holding the manager's email address (or phone number)", links "once every row in the file exists", "through the same refusals", and reports on "the row's `manager` result", and "a link it cannot make never fails the user it imported": `admin-import-users.ts`, section "`manager_id` — admitted, and resolved in a SECOND pass", reads that way word for word (identity key, second pass, `applyUserManagerLink`, `rows[].manager`, "A manager problem never costs the row its identity").
  - "the node's `onEmptyApprovers` policy decides … by default the request opens and waits for an administrator": as accepted on #22584 (`approval-service.ts`, `?? 'admin_rescue'`).
  - The removed clause ("its admin bulk import does not write it either") was false for the same reason.
- **Gates:** 40 of 40 derived families at `992302698c` (the PR head), all exit 0, with `--ran` "0 NOT-MEASURED". The usage-wall death and resume are declared, and every gate was re-run after the resume. CI convergence is read by the seat before ready.
- **Acceptance notes:**
  - `filed #22683` (the `os lint` remedy string and its pin still say the bulk import does not write `manager_id`; class (a), named producer).
  - Three notes stay in the PR's Acceptance notes with no carrier: the Console import wizard offers no `manager_id` column; `permissions/authentication.mdx` does not document it; "the submitter's manager" wording against `record[value] ?? record.owner_id`.

Landing: ready plus auto-merge once every check on the head is green.
